name: Ghorepani and Poon Hill
why: The short classic from Pokhara: up 3,300 stone steps to Ulleri and the rhododendron forest of Ghorepani, then sunrise on Dhaulagiri and Annapurna from Poon Hill.
book: Annapurna Conservation Area permit and TIMS card. Since April 2023 Nepal requires foreign trekkers to hire a licensed guide in its national parks and conservation areas (check the current rule before you go). Jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul or Birethanti (1.5 h).
dangers: Steep stone steps between Tikhedhunga and Ulleri.
Ice on the steps up Poon Hill on winter mornings: use a headlamp.
turnaround: Leave Ghorepani at 04:45 for sunrise; if the summit is in cloud by 07:00, it will not clear.

points.name: Birethanti
points.note: A village at the river crossing where the ACAP checkpost checks your permit.

points.name: Ulleri
points.note: A Magar village at the top of the famous stone staircase.

points.name: Ghorepani
